notes.title: Paw Pirates Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I just wanted to create a quick post to let you know that due to delays in the steam review process resulting from a late submission on our end, the game's release will be delayed by a few days. 

Sorry about this, but stay patient! we're really excited for you all to have the opportunity to play.

-Murray

notes.title: Paw Pirates Release Approaches
notes.notes:
Hello Paw Pirates nation!


We are beyond excited to finally release the game, and the release date is in less than a week!

This past year of development has been such an incredible journey, and we can't wait for you to finally get a chance to play the full release! 

We've been hard at work adding the finishing touches to the game! 

Remember to play the game on [b]January 3rd, 2025[/b] when it releases!

There are few BIG surprises waiting for you in the full game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984134/25ace544cf7a8ad71913781ca76523e2b6d2819c.png[/img]



Thank you for your support!!!

-Murray
